section.content: 本实用新型公开了一种锂离子电池，包括采用螺栓连接的上盖和下盖，沿纵向方向堆叠布设、且置于上盖和下盖内的三元锂电池，设置在三元锂电池的底部的电池支架，设置在电池支架的底部的端板，贴合在三元锂电池表面的第一冷却板和第二冷却板，设置在三元锂电池的端部的电气盖，设置在三元锂电池与电气盖之间的绝缘板，以及设置在电气盖上、且与三元锂电池电气连接的电池管理系统；上盖上设置有数个电气连接接口；所述电气连接接口与三元锂电池和电池管理系统电气连接；所述上盖上设置有两个散热器接头；所述散热器接头与第一冷却板和第二冷却板一一对应连接。通过上述方案，本实用新型具有结构简单、集成度高、防护可靠等优点。

The utility model discloses a lithium ion battery, including the upper cover and the lower cover that adopt bolted connection, pile up along the longitudinal direction and lay, and arrange the ternary lithium cell in upper cover and lower cover in, set up the battery support in the bottom of ternary lithium cell, set up the end plate in the bottom of battery support, the first cooling plate and the second cooling plate of laminating on ternary lithium cell surface, set up the electric lid at the tip of ternary lithium cell, the insulation board of setting between ternary lithium cell and electric lid, and set up on electric lid, and with the battery management system of ternary lithium cell electrical connection; the upper cover is provided with a plurality of electrical connection interfaces; the electrical connection interface is electrically connected with the ternary lithium battery and the battery management system; the upper cover is provided with two radiator joints; the radiator joints are connected with the first cooling plate and the second cooling plate in a one-to-one correspondence mode. By the proposal, the utility model has the advantages of simple structure, integrated level are high, the protection is reliable.

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The utility model belongs to the technical field of the car battery technique and specifically relates to a lithium ion battery.

Background

The lithium ion battery herein mainly refers to a 48V ternary lithium battery. Over the last century, the content of various greenhouse gases such as carbon dioxide and sulfur dioxide in the air has been increasing due to the use of fossil fuels such as coal and petroleum, and the "greenhouse effect" has become more and more serious. Under the promotion of policies, new energy automobiles realize the leap-type development in recent years, particularly pure electric vehicles are completely exposed, and the automobile industry is promoted to take an important step in the future. As legislation becomes more stringent for automotive energy efficiency, the living space of conventional fuel vehicles is becoming smaller and smaller. The 48v light mixing technology improves the fuel oil rate by reducing the carbon dioxide emission, so that enterprises can control the carbon emission in the requirements of national policies.

At present, most 48V lithium ion batteries in the prior art adopt a traditional battery series connection mode, and have the defects of poor protective performance, low integration degree and the like.

Therefore, it is urgently needed to provide a lithium ion battery with the advantages of simple structure, high integration level, reliable protection and the like.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

In view of the above, an object of the present invention is to provide a lithium ion battery, the utility model discloses a technical scheme as follows:

a lithium ion battery comprises an upper cover and a lower cover which are connected by bolts, a ternary lithium battery which is stacked and arranged along the longitudinal direction and is arranged in the upper cover and the lower cover, a battery support which is arranged at the bottom of the ternary lithium battery, an end plate which is arranged at the bottom of the battery support, a first cooling plate and a second cooling plate which are attached to the surface of the ternary lithium battery, an electric cover which is arranged at the end part of the ternary lithium battery, an insulating plate which is arranged between the ternary lithium battery and the electric cover, and a battery management system which is arranged on the electric cover and is electrically connected with the ternary lithium battery; the first cooling plate, the end plate, the battery bracket, the ternary lithium battery, the electric cover, the battery management system, the second cooling plate and the insulating plate are all arranged in the upper cover and the lower cover; the edge of the ternary lithium battery is provided with a plurality of screw rods from top to bottom; the bottom of the screw is connected with an end plate; the upper cover is provided with a plurality of electrical connection interfaces; the electrical connection interface is electrically connected with the ternary lithium battery and the battery management system; two radiator joints are arranged on the upper cover; the radiator joints are connected with the first cooling plate and the second cooling plate in a one-to-one correspondence mode.

Furthermore, the inner walls of the upper cover and the lower cover are provided with neoprene foam.

Compared with the prior art, the utility model discloses following beneficial effect has:

(1) the utility model skillfully adopts the aluminum box consisting of the upper cover and the lower cover, which are connected by the bolt seal and provide support protection; and chloroprene rubber foam is arranged in the upper cover and the lower cover to provide buffer support;

(2) the utility model discloses a set up end plate, battery holder and screw rod to realize ternary lithium cell fixed connection, and the utility model discloses a set up first cooling plate and second cooling plate, in order to guarantee that the heat dissipation is reliable;

to sum up, the utility model has the advantages of simple structure, integrated level height, protection are reliable, have very high practical value and spreading value in car battery technical field.

Drawings

In order to more clearly illustrate the technical solutions of the embodiments of the present invention, the drawings required for the embodiments will be briefly described below, it should be understood that the following drawings only illustrate some embodiments of the present invention, and therefore should not be considered as a limitation of the scope of protection, and for those skilled in the art, other related drawings may be obtained from these drawings without inventive effort.

Fig. 1 is a schematic structural diagram of the present invention.

Fig. 2 is a schematic diagram of the internal structure of the present invention.

In the drawings, the names of the parts corresponding to the reference numerals are as follows:

1. an upper cover; 2. a lower cover; 3. soaking the chloroprene rubber into cotton; 4. a first cooling plate; 5. an end plate; 6. a battery holder; 7. a ternary lithium battery; 8. an electrical cover; 9. a battery management system; 10. a second cooling plate; 11. an insulating plate; 12. a screw.

Detailed Description

To make the objectives, technical solutions and advantages of the present application more clear, the present invention will be further described with reference to the accompanying drawings and examples, and embodiments of the present invention include, but are not limited to, the following examples. All other embodiments, which can be derived by a person skilled in the art from the embodiments given herein without making any creative effort, shall fall within the protection scope of the present application.

Examples

As shown in fig. 1 to 2, the present embodiment provides a lithium ion battery. In the present embodiment, the terms "first", "second", and the like are used only for distinguishing the similar components, and are not to be construed as limiting the scope of protection. In addition, in the present embodiment, the directional terms such as "bottom", "top", "side", "edge", and the like are explained based on the drawings. Furthermore, the present embodiment is based on the improvement of the structure, and does not improve the use of aluminum material, chloroprene rubber, or the like. The battery management system of the present embodiment is an existing mature component.

The lithium ion battery of this embodiment, including adopting bolted connection's upper cover 1 and lower cover 2, the neoprene bubble cotton 3 of setting at the inner wall of upper cover 1 and lower cover 2, pile up along longitudinal direction and lay, and arrange the ternary lithium cell 7 in upper cover 1 and lower cover 2 in, set up the battery support 6 in the bottom of ternary lithium cell 7, the end plate 5 of setting in the bottom of battery support 6, the laminating is at first cooling plate 4 and the second cooling plate 10 on ternary lithium cell 7 surface, the electric lid 8 of setting at the tip of ternary lithium cell 7, the insulation board 11 of setting between ternary lithium cell 7 and electric lid 8, and set up on electric lid 8, and with ternary lithium cell electric connection's battery management system 9. And a plurality of screw rods 12 are arranged on the edge of the ternary lithium battery 7 from top to bottom, and the bottoms of the screw rods 12 are connected with the end plate 5.

The first cooling plate 4, the end plate 5, the battery support 6, the ternary lithium battery 7, the electrical cover 8, the battery management system 9, the second cooling plate 10 and the insulating plate 11 of the present embodiment are disposed in the upper cover 1 and the lower cover 2. In addition, in order to realize the electrical connection with the outside, a plurality of electrical connection interfaces are arranged on the upper cover 1; the electrical connection interface is electrically connected with the ternary lithium battery 7 and the battery management system 9. Meanwhile, two radiator joints are arranged on the upper cover 1; the radiator joints are correspondingly connected with the first cooling plate 4 and the second cooling plate 10.

The above-mentioned embodiments are merely preferred embodiments of the present invention, and are not limitations on the protection scope of the present invention, but all the changes made by adopting the design principle of the present invention and performing non-creative work on this basis shall fall within the protection scope of the present invention.
